gloss: A thin fibrous-muscular sheet under the fat; face-lift plane and a reconstructive option after parotidectomy.
role: Over the gland lie, from outside in, the skin, a layer of fat, a thin fibrous sheet called the SMAS, and the gland's own tough capsule.
matters: To lower the chance of Frey syndrome, surgeons can put a layer between the skin flap and the bed left by the gland: the thin fibrous sheet (SMAS) sewn back, a strip of neck muscle, a graft or a manufactured sheet. Each has some support in studies, none of it strong.
